title: Minties Dog Dental Bone Treats, Tiny/Small Dental Dog Treats, 16 Ounces, Cleans Teeth, Fight Bad Breath, Removes Plaque and Tartar, 40 Count

reviews.title: Solid Little Dental Chew
reviews.body: Solid little dental chews for small dogs. My pup actually looks forward to these, and I’ve noticed less tartar buildup and fresher breath since starting them as a daily treat. The tiny size is perfect portioning for small breeds, and they don’t crumble apart like some cheaper dental treats do.A few things worth knowing: they’re a treat, not a replacement for brushing, so I still do that a couple times a week. Also 80 count goes fast if you’re giving one daily to multiple dogs.Overall good value and my dog genuinely enjoys them, which makes dental care a lot easier. Would buy again.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on June 30, 2026
reviews.author: Susan

reviews.title: Minties Chews nail dental health perfectly
reviews.body: Love these Minties chews. The 100 count pack is great value and lasts a long time. My dog's dental health seems better and breath is noticeably fresher.
